reference_point.source: Shi et al. 2020 reports the Xingping reference location as no-deformation; UNGEGN city-coordinate anchor (ID 2459), with local pixel selected by coherence

quality_note: NISAR L2 GUNW CRID P05023 provisional products only; calibration and validation are carried out by NASA-JPL/ISRO.
method_note: Headline value = most negative median of ~1 km blocks (13x13 px, >= 50 % valid pixels, within-block std <= 2 cm) of the cumulative LOS map. Rate = linear extrapolation of 120 days (2026-06-19 to 2026-10-17, summer season) to one year: an ESTIMATE that likely overstates the annual net rate because part of summer subsidence recovers in winter. Vertical value assumes purely vertical motion (LOS / cos(incidence)). range_cm = spread of the headline value when the whole chain is re-referenced to up to two other stable windows >= 30 km away.

reference_anchor.window: 7x7 common-valid pixels; nearest high-coherence window within 3 km of source locality
